text:
Ah, the humble candle. Its primary material? Wax, obviously. But let’s be honest, in the grand theater of adulthood, wax is merely the prop we use to simulate romance while we quietly weep over our electric bills.

Welcome to the golden age of "spontaneity," where the thrill of choosing between Chicken and Beef instant noodles rivals the excitement of a first date. It’s a high-stakes gamble, really. Will the noodles be soggy? Will they be crunchy? The uncertainty is enough to make your back ache before you’ve even taken a bite.

And let’s not forget the pinnacle of long-term strategic planning: the Netflix scroll. We spend forty-five minutes debating whether to rewatch *The Office* for the tenth time or finally start that documentary about deep-sea squids. It’s exhausting work, this adulting. But hey, at least the candle is burning down, marking the time until we have to go to sleep and do it all again tomorrow. Truly, a magical journey.
